Name: Auto Water Crops (configuable per-day)
Author: TheFluffyRobot
Description:
[i][center][/center][/i][center][i]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/scTNM7E.png[/img][/i][i]﻿
[/i][/center][center][i](aka auto-water your crops on configured days)[/i][size=5][/size][/center][size=5]
[/size][size=6]Purpose[/size][size=5]
[/size][size=4]The purpose of this mod is to have your weekend be a bit more relaxing by
having all of your crops be watered for you on configured days. By
default this is on Saturdays and Sundays.[/size][size=5]
[/size]
[size=6]Instructions[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=4][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿ (requies 4.0.0 or above)[/size]
[*][size=4]Download this mod and unzip the WeekendRelaxation folder into Stardew [/size]
[size=4]Valley/Mods. The latter can be found in your game's installation
directory[/size]
[*][size=4]Run the game as you would, per the SMAPI instructions[/size]
[/list][size=6]Compatability
[list]
[*] [size=3]Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+[/size]
[*][size=3][size=6][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows [i](untested on other platforms)[/i][/size][/size][/size]
[*][size=3] Works with other mods [i](in the rare case other mods that adjust when tiles are watered)[/i][/size]
[*][size=3] Works in multiplayer and in splitscreen[/size]
[*][size=3]If you discover a bug, leave a comment on this page or create a [url=https://github.com/jamespfluger/Stardew-EqualMoneySplit/issues/new]new issue on GitHub[/url]﻿﻿ to track it[/size]
[/list][/size][size=6]
[/size]

Downloads.Description:
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14

Requires SMAPI 4.0.0+ and Generic Mod Config 1.12.0


BUGFIX: Configuration now saves across weeks, seasons, and sesssions


Days can be configured

Manifest.Name: Auto Crop Watering (configurable per-day)
Manifest.Description: Automatically waters crops on days configured, defaults to Saaturdays and Sundays.
